items.Sentence: They receive, export, and store secondary treated domestic, commercial, and industrial wastewater from the cities of Dublin, Livermore, and Pleasanton.
LAVWMA wastewater also contains reverse osmosis reject water from the Zone 7 Water Agency that is mixed with the Dublin San Ramon Services District’s final effluent.
The Marina Dechlorination Facility dechlorinates treated and disinfected effluent from the EBDA and LAVWMA member agencies using sodium bisulfite.
